backup.production_rule: SINGLE SHOT: the migration is not re-runnable. A second run stops on its own md5 guard by design (the four bodies are no longer the ones it was cut from); to undo, apply the rollback. Apply AFTER s81_notices_20261014 and s81_staff_pay_push_20261014 (and the s79 and s78 releases they follow): the first block of the migration stops (55000, nothing changed) unless staff_home_v1, notices_v1, staff_pay_admin_list_v1 and staff_pay_settle_v1 are exactly the bodies this release was cut from (md5 of prosrc, CR stripped: apply_inventory_purchase e71d6a691a9af5e8fd5677a2857d9cd2, save_shopping_item_v1 4429199a1b728c79cf82d86c01b17903, staff_home d04e3c492bbeba8722554ac5c951c928, notices f3f0653167ffaa39fa155287a13b913a, admin_list 067d97c248b17221574c7d4b8b57a3f9, settle dda64b4a8f57fdf1b3d036ca458482d7). Additive except six function bodies and one grant: (1) ops_notices.source_url (nullable, http/https check) and notices_v1 returns it as url; (2) staff_home_v1 = the live body plus counted insertions that add arrival_ready {id, paid, door_code} for owner/admin sessions only (cleaner and finance payloads byte-identical: the key is absent, not null); paid is true only for Airbnb stays and door_code is null, because no source exists (the balance is not recorded and the PIN is set by hand); (3) table cleaning_progress (RLS, no grants) with cleaning_progress_set_v1 (submit_cleaning) and cleaning_progress_v1 (manage_operations: owner/admin); (4) MONEY: staff_pay_admin_list_v1 gains unrequested and paid_by_name; staff_pay_admin_create_v1 makes a normal requested row for a staff member (approve_payment), same rate rule, guards, row locks and line shapes as staff_pay_request_create_v1, idempotent on (payee, key), marked staff_pay_requests.created_by_user_id; staff_pay_candidates_v1 and staff_pay_request_create_v1 are NOT touched; (5) staff_pay_settle_v1: a settle from the Staff app (no Telegram id, actor ending " via Staff app") is logged "<name> via Staff app" and its claim note says so; Telegram settles keep "Telegram: <name>"; (6) INVENTORY (owner decision 2026-10-15, staff count in the app): apply_inventory_purchase (Telegram receipt restock) writes the matching receipt movement through s_inventory_purchase_movement_v1 when the item is movement-controlled (a repeat of the same p_txn_id is answered by a notes match inside apply_inventory_purchase, not by the helper key; the helper refuses unless a purchase row exists for that item; actor = the signed-in person, else the person who reconciled the item; refuses an item whose ledger disagrees), uncontrolled items run the old statements unchanged; inventory_shopping_list: authenticated loses SELECT on estimated_cost, unit_cost and supplier (direct reads of those columns now fail, so select(*) fails) and the new definer get_shopping_list_v1 returns them only to finance_human_authorized sessions; save_shopping_item_v1: without manage_inventory a person may only create rows and edit or cancel proposed rows she proposed herself. Also (7) staff_pay_admin_create_v1 refuses the caller as payee (reason self) and a disabled or ineligible payee (payee_not_allowed); staff_pay_admin_list_v1 marks each unrequested entry self (true for the caller only, still listed for other admins); plus s_weekly_sweep_v1 and the pg_cron job s82-pay-weekly-sweep (Sunday 22:30 UTC) which asks notify-cleaner-payment once more for requests paid in the last 7 days whose notice was never claimed (the function claims once) and deletes staff_upload_hashes older than 90 days and cleaning_progress rows older than 14 days. Uses the existing Vault secret cascade_cron_shared_secret; no new secret. Rehearsed 2026-10-15 on a disposable local copy (recovery baseline plus every forward migration, applied as postgres): s82_staff_31.sql 101 of 101, s82_staff_31_fix.sql 46 of 46 (red on the first version of this release); the s81, s79, staff_pay_requests, staff_home_v1, calendar_day_flags and ops_notices_rls suites green after the apply and again after the rollback; the s82 file is red on the rolled-back state. restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: take a fresh backup as the LAST act before the apply and fill both (fill-restore-point.mjs).
backup.notes: Deploy order, exactly: (1) the admin dashboard build that reads get_shopping_list_v1 goes live FIRST (its purchases page used select(*) on inventory_shopping_list, which this SQL breaks); (2) then this SQL; (3) then the functions power-watch, telegram-cassy, telegram-expense (they write ops_notices.source_url only when a link exists; before the SQL a link would make the insert fail). Secrets by name: CASCADE_CRON_SHARED_SECRET (existing).
